races.paceDynamic: Layla Liz and Ruby's Profit will ensure strong early pace, with both having confirmed front-running tendencies and likely to dispute the early lead over this sharp 5f trip. The honest gallop they create will stretch the field, particularly dangerous given the downhill nature of Epsom's 5f course which amplifies pace pressure. Several prominent runners like Equality, Master Of My Fate, and the Cowell trio (Lexington Blitz, Rhythm N Hooves, Michaela's Boy) will look to track the pace closely. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers and closers with tactical speed - the sustained gallop will set up perfectly for hold-up horses with finishing kick to sweep up the pace-pressed leaders.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained Pace Favours Closers
scenarios.trigger: If Layla Liz and Ruby's Profit maintain honest fractions throughout the opening 3f
scenarios.body: The strong gallop stretches the field and softens up the pace-setters for a closer to strike. Hold-up horses with proven finishing speed get the perfect setup to unleash late.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Pair Dominate Early
scenarios.trigger: If one of the front-runners gets soft sectionals by taking a clear lead
scenarios.body: Without pressure, the leader can control fractions and prove hard to peg back over this stiff 5f. The pace collapses and early speed holds sway.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Pack Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners get the perfect trip tracking the leaders closely
scenarios.body: The likes of Lexington Blitz or Rhythm N Hooves get first run on the pace-setters while avoiding the worst of the early speed duel. They hit the front with 1f to run and hold on.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If both front-runners fail to handle the pressure and fade quickly
scenarios.body: The race becomes tactical with no sustained gallop, suiting horses that can quicken from close range. The race falls apart and any horse with a turn of foot can win.

races.paceDynamic: Benvenuto Cellini, Balzac, Menzies and A Taste Of Glory will ensure a proper gallop from the off, with Action and the Appleby trio (Shabab Al Ahli, Pursuit Of Love, Study Of Words) sitting handy. The strong pace will stretch the field early on Epsom's unique undulations, creating genuine stamina pressure despite the 1m2f trip. Hold-up horses like Wise Prince and Shayem face a tactical nightmare with limited cover and kick-back points around Epsom's cambered turns. This race shape strongly favors prominent racers who can track the pace without getting embroiled in the early burn-up.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the pace-setters overdid it and prominent horses get first run
scenarios.body: The strong gallop sets up perfectly for horses like Action or Shabab Al Ahli who can track without leading, then pounce when the leaders weaken climbing to the line. Epsom's downhill-uphill configuration punishes pure front-runners while rewarding those just off the pace.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Hero Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses and allows cover for closers
scenarios.body: Wise Prince or Shayem get the splits they need around Tattenham Corner and unleash devastating late kicks up the hill. The class of Wise Prince particularly could shine if Robert Havlin times his move perfectly.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace-Setter Survives
scenarios.trigger: If one leader gets away with softer fractions than expected
scenarios.body: Benvenuto Cellini's class tells as he dictates terms and kicks clear, or A Taste Of Glory repeats his recent Salisbury win by controlling the tempo. The 5lb penalty for Benvenuto Cellini becomes irrelevant if he gets an easy lead.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Chaos Around Corner
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is so strong that longshots emerge from nowhere
scenarios.body: The fierce gallop and Epsom's tricky turns create a muddling finish where horses like Green Falcon or Pearl River sneak through on the rails. Form goes out the window as the race becomes a war of attrition.

races.paceDynamic: Atherstone Warrior, Alcarath, and Fierce Fortitude will ensure a strong gallop from the start, with all three confirmed front-runners likely to engage early. The large field of 22 runners combined with this aggressive pace will create a demanding test of stamina over Epsom's undulating 1m2f trip. The relentless gallop will stretch the field and expose any lacking stamina reserves. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses and late closers who can conserve energy early and finish fastest when the pace collapses.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If the three front-runners engage in a genuine speed duel through the first half-mile
scenarios.body: The sustained gallop will empty the tanks of prominent racers and create ideal conditions for closers with tactical speed. Hold-up specialists like Sallaal, Eternal Force, and Alpha Crucis can exploit the pace scenario perfectly.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Tactical Battle Develops
scenarios.trigger: If one front-runner dominates early while the others settle just behind
scenarios.body: A more controlled tempo allows prominent racers to stay closer and mount sustained challenges, though stamina remains key over this demanding course. Horses like Insanity and Respond can use their class advantage.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front-Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Fierce Fortitude or Alcarath gets an uncontested lead with the others failing to go with them
scenarios.body: The leader can dictate terms and potentially stay on for victory, especially with Fierce Fortitude's recent winning form and light weight. The pace becomes less punishing for all.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Scrappy Finish
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is moderate throughout with multiple groups converging late
scenarios.body: A bunched finish favours horses with the best recent form and tactical positioning, regardless of running style. Class and jockey skill become decisive factors.

races.paceDynamic: Atherstone Warrior, Topteam, Antrim, Square Necker and Fierce Fortitude will ensure a strong gallop from the start over this stamina-sapping 1m4f trip at Epsom. The downhill nature of the track will see them go even faster than usual, with Topteam and Atherstone Warrior likely to dispute the early lead. This sustained pace over the peculiar Epsom contours will stretch the field and test stamina reserves to the limit. Hold-up horses with proven stamina and tactical speed will be best positioned to strike late when the pace-setters weaken.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If the five confirmed leaders go too hard early and the pace becomes unsustainable
scenarios.body: The strong gallop will stretch the field but ultimately favour the patient hold-up horses who can pick up the pieces when the leaders tire on the testing undulations. Horses like Too Soon, Master Builder and Analogical will benefit from the setup.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Tactical Battle Develops
scenarios.trigger: If the pace-setters are more restrained than expected and multiple horses remain in contention
scenarios.body: A more tactical affair will suit the prominent racers who can position themselves well without using too much energy early. The likes of Night Breeze and Asgard's Captain can track the pace and have enough left to finish strongly.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If one of the leaders manages their effort perfectly and the pace proves sustainable
scenarios.body: Topteam or Atherstone Warrior could prove too strong if they can dictate terms and kick clear when it matters. Their recent form suggests they have the class to make all or most of the running successfully.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Moderate Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is surprisingly steady with most leaders showing restraint
scenarios.body: A slowly-run race would favour horses with a devastating turn of foot rather than pure stamina. This scenario would significantly disadvantage the hold-up horses who rely on a strong pace to bring them into contention.

races.paceDynamic: Pureis King will take this race up from the gates and likely get an easy lead with no other natural front runners in the field. The prominent racers Domenico Contarini, Princling and Exquisite Skye will track behind but none are aggressive pace forcers, allowing Pureis King to dictate terms through steady fractions. With a large field of hold-up horses including Knights Charge, Fizzy Bear and Nuptown Girl all needing the race to develop, traffic problems are inevitable in the straight. This tactical setup strongly favours prominent racers who can position close to the pace and avoid the scramble, while hold-up horses face significant disadvantages.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Holds
scenarios.trigger: If Pureis King gets soft fractions and the field sits too far back early
scenarios.body: The pace-setter gets first run turning for home while the hold-up brigade gets caught in traffic behind a wall of horses. Despite his tendency to fade, Pureis King exploits perfect positioning while prominent trackers like Princling and Exquisite Skye pick up the pieces.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Domenico Contarini or Princling apply pressure to Pureis King from the home turn
scenarios.body: The sustained pace finds out the leader's stamina while the prominent racers get ideal trips stalking the speed. Domenico Contarini's recent proximity to winners or Princling's Tom Marquand partnership proves decisive with clear runs in the straight.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Hero Threading
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and gaps appear for late runners
scenarios.body: Knights Charge and Nuptown Girl get dream scenarios with Shane Foley and the mare's staying power coming to the fore in a slowly run race. The combination of weak pace and clear passages allows one hold-up horse to showcase superior class through traffic.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Newcomer Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If one of the unexposed debutants Champion Lawman, Hattie's Comet or Turret shows significant ability
scenarios.body: The well-bred newcomer from Charlie Johnston, Jim Boyle or Andrew Balding yards exploits race positioning while more exposed runners underperform. Superior talent overcomes tactical disadvantage through class alone.

races.paceDynamic: On Message and Assaranca will contest the early lead with both having clear front-running tendencies, creating an honest gallop from the outset. The presence of prominent runners Aerial Silk, Mayaada and Runswick means the pace will be sustained through the middle stages, preventing any soft sectionals. The large field of 15 runners on Epsom's unique topography will create additional pace pressure as horses jostle for position around Tattenham Corner. This sustained tempo strongly favours hold-up horses who can stay out of trouble early and deliver late challenges.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Early Pace
scenarios.trigger: If On Message and Assaranca both go forward aggressively from the start
scenarios.body: The dual pace-setters will create a searching gallop that suits closers who can pick up the pieces in the final two furlongs. Hold-up horses with proven finishing kicks will benefit most from this tempo.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Moderate Gallop Setup
scenarios.trigger: If one of the front runners settles or drops out early
scenarios.body: A more measured tempo allows prominent racers to get into good rhythm and kick clear before the hold-up horses get organized. Mid-division runners can position perfectly for Epsom's demands.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical Battle
scenarios.trigger: If both front runners are restrained creating a slow early pace
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace will bunch the field and create a sprint finish where horses with natural speed have the edge. Those closest to the pace when the sprint begins will have crucial positional advantage.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If the early leaders go too fast and stop dramatically in the straight
scenarios.body: Complete pace collapse allows the most patient hold-up horses to sweep past tired leaders and deliver sustained challenges. Only horses held up in last third of field benefit.

watchPoints.text: On Message faces major fitness test after 197-day absence and may not sustain gallop if pressed early

races.paceDynamic: Bubbles Wonky is the sole confirmed front runner in this 18-runner field, likely to dictate terms from the outset without serious early pressure. Sweet Reward, Jimmy Speaking, Hot Cash, It'sneverjustone, Silver Trumpet and Amused should press forward into prominent positions, creating a decent gallop but not frenetic pace. The large field of hold-up horses including El Matador, Mr Baloo, Principality, Knights Gold and Shafdar will be tracking from midfield and beyond on Epsom's undulating 1m4f course. This sustainable pace setup clearly favours the prominent racers and strong travellers who can position handy and kick, rather than the pure front runner or the hold-up brigade who may struggle to make up ground in such a large field.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Racers Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays honest but not pedestrian with good positioning battles
scenarios.body: Sweet Reward and Jimmy Speaking can use their prominent styles to perfection, tracking Bubbles Wonky before striking in the straight. The hold-up horses get caught too far back in the big field while the lone leader gets outkicked.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Strong Traveller Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If one of the hold-up horses gets the perfect trip through the field
scenarios.body: Mr Baloo or Principality can use their class to weave through and deliver a telling blow in the final furlong. Their superior ratings tell when getting clear runs from patient tactics.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Suits Leader
scenarios.trigger: If Bubbles Wonky gets uncontested fractions and kicks clear turning in
scenarios.body: The lack of early pressure allows the front runner to build an unassailable lead down Epsom's demanding hill. Late closers can't peg back the advantage despite their finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Chaos Helps Outsider
scenarios.trigger: If the large field creates traffic problems and interference in the straight
scenarios.body: A lightly weighted runner like Amused or Atlantis Blue can benefit from a clear passage while the fancied horses get hampered. The tactical free-for-all throws up an unexpected winner.
